source.title: AWS plans to add over one million NVIDIA GPUs
source.titleZH: AWS 计划新增超过 100 万颗 NVIDIA GPU
source.summary: AWS announced an expansion starting in 2026, covering Blackwell and Rubin GPUs as well as networking collaboration.
source.summaryZH: AWS 宣布从 2026 年起扩大部署，覆盖 Blackwell、Rubin GPU，并开展网络基础设施合作。
source.claim: AWS and Nvidia just signed one of the largest cloud deals in history. This 1 million chip agreement spans through 2027, covering the full stack from Blackwell to Rubin and Spectrum networking.
source.excerpt: AWS will add more than 1 million NVIDIA GPUs including Blackwell and Rubin GPU architectures
source.locator: Accelerating compute capacity in the agentic AI era
source.contextNote: This is AWS's deployment announcement, not NVIDIA's revenue recognition. This document does not establish the author's 2027 completion date or long-term investment conclusion.
source.contextNoteZH: 这是 AWS 的部署公告，不等于 NVIDIA 已确认收入；本文件未确定作者所说的 2027 年完成时间，也不证明其长期投资结论。

source.title: Nebius discloses the Microsoft infrastructure agreement
source.titleZH: Nebius 披露与 Microsoft 的基础设施协议
source.summary: The filing specifies about $17.4B of conditional contract value through 2031; additional capacity could lift it to about $19.4B.
source.summaryZH: 申报文件披露，截至 2031 年的合同价值约 174 亿美元，取决于部署及服务可用性；额外容量可使其增至约 194 亿美元。
source.excerpt: the total contract value is about $17.4 billion through 2031.
source.contextNote: Contract value is not revenue already earned. This document does not establish Cursor's current revenue or its contribution to Nebius.
source.contextNoteZH: 合同价值不等于已实现收入。本文件不证明 Cursor 当前的收入规模或其对 Nebius 的收入贡献。
